findings.description: Validator accepts spaces, parentheses, hyphens in phone numbers, but _submit() strips them before sending. If backend validation expects formatted input or logs show unexpected values, this mismatch is the cause.
findings.recommendation: Either relax the validator to match submission format or keep formatting characters in submission.

findings.description: TextButton uses context.pop() instead of context.go(AppRoutes.login). If user arrives via deep link or bookmark (no navigation stack), pop() won't navigate to login.
findings.recommendation: Use context.go(AppRoutes.login) for explicit navigation or verify that all entry paths to /register come from login screen.
